name: KW Solar Solutions, Inc
old_description: Since 2004, KW Solar Solutions, Inc has helped hundreds of customers power their homes through solar energy. We offer photovoltaic (PV) energy systems for homes and other residential properties in Maryland & Delaware
about:
KW Solar Solutions, Inc is based in Elkton, Maryland, and has been operating since 2004 as a family-owned business. The company was founded by Dale Wolf, who serves as president and CEO and holds NABCEP certification as both an installer and electrician. Wolf remains the owner-operator, and the firm describes itself as a locally owned and operated mid-Atlantic company.

The company designs, installs, and maintains photovoltaic (PV) systems for residential, commercial, and agricultural customers across Maryland, Delaware, and southern Chester County, Pennsylvania. Services include custom system design, permitting and paperwork handling, installation, repair, replacement, inspection, monitoring, battery backup integration, system upgrades, remove-and-reinstall for roof replacements, and pest guard installation. All electrical work is performed by in-house master electricians without outsourcing. The firm also assists customers with utility interconnection, grant applications, Renewable Energy Generator certification, and the sale of Solar Renewable Energy Credits (SRECs) through SREC Delaware and SREC Trade.

KW Solar serves homeowners, businesses, farms, non-profits, and educational institutions. Its service area covers Cecil and Harford counties in Maryland, New Castle and Kent counties in Delaware, and towns such as Oxford, Avondale, and Kennett Square in Pennsylvania. The company emphasizes familiarity with local incentives, permitting requirements, and utility policies.

The company highlights its 20-plus years of local experience, full in-house service model, use of American-made components, and commitment to code-compliant, licensed, and insured installations as key differentiators. It also offers financing options and promotes a transparent, customer-focused approach.
